verificationPolicy: Source and Node checks are supplementary. Completion requires a real portrait-browser battle on this exact candidate, including target geometry, support/MISS/error gate release, the four-track layout, six-slot density, and the lazy-loaded formation editor.

requirements.requirement: Combat resolves immutable targetSide, targetId and targetIds before V142/V143; VFX never reads the action queue, hit order or survivor bounds to guess targets.
requirements.remaining: Verify player, enemy and Purify Mind enemy-target casts in the exact candidate browser runtime.

requirements.requirement: Single VFX centers on its card; tri stays three-slot sized with one survivor; all stays complete-side sized; projectiles travel from caster center to primary-target center; no stage or ancestor clips the raster.
requirements.remaining: Verify representative fire, water, wind and earth casts plus one-survivor tri/all in a portrait browser.

requirements.requirement: Battle cards stay above the middle action/round controls, allies follow, battle info owns the bottom track, and the element-box button is 66 px without covering primary controls.
requirements.remaining: Run the three-viewport browser geometry suite on the exact candidate.

requirements.requirement: Enemy and ally names, statuses, HP and SP use below-art fixed anchors; front/back rows have a real gap and six occupied ally slots do not overlap.
requirements.remaining: Complete portrait-browser six-slot, BOSS, reinforcement and mechanism-card visual inspection.

requirements.requirement: The home Formation button loads gameplay-core on its first click, opens the existing Fixed Slot editor and persists actual slot swaps.
requirements.remaining: Open Formation from a cold home screen and swap two characters in the candidate browser.

requirements.requirement: Hit, MISS, tri, all, enemy, buff, heal, revive, shield, debuff, render failure and DOM exceptions cannot deadlock initiative or battle-end handoff.
requirements.remaining: Run a sustained candidate battle through multiple rounds and its end transition, including Ice Arrow Rain and forced MISS/error paths.

blockers: Exact-candidate real browser verification is pending before this batch can be marked VERIFIED.
